title: 解锁车门时，误把列表序号加进工具名
summary: 用户希望解锁全部车门，并打开车灯。工具列表中的第 16 项是 `lockDoors`，第 20 项是 `setHeadlights`。16 和 20 只是列表序号，不属于工具名。

question.content: Hey there, I noticed that all of my car doors seem to have locked themselves up, and with my schedule being pretty tight today, I'm in quite a pinch. I could really use your help to get those doors unlocked. It'd be fantastic if you could also switch on the headlights. It's getting a bit darker out here than expected, and visibility's not great!

branches.title: 无指导
branches.summary: 把列表序号加进工具名，解锁和开灯都报错，重试后仍未成功。
branches.frameTitle: 工具调用与返回 · 节选

reasoning.title: 无指导 · 推理节选
reasoning.text:
From the list_tools response, there's mcp_tool_16 called LockDoors.
…
Then, for the headlights, there's mcp_tool_20 SetHeadlights.

branches.title: Teacher 指导后
branches.summary: 使用正确的工具名解锁车门，随后继续打开车灯。

reasoning.title: Teacher 指导后 · 推理节选
reasoning.text:
From the list_tools response, there's mcp_tool_lockDoors which can unlock doors.
…
Also, there's mcp_tool_setHeadlights with a mode parameter. Setting mode="on" should activate the headlights.

guidance.title: 用正确的工具名完成操作

fields.precondition: User reports car doors locked and requests unlocking along with activating headlights.
fields.decision_rule: Check available tools for door unlocking and headlight activation functions.
fields.expected_transition: Call mcp_tool_lockDoors with unlock=True and all doors, followed by mcp_tool_setHeadlights with mode="on".
fields.recovery_check: Verify door status and headlight status post-tool execution to ensure functionality.

checks.局部核验: 四扇车门均已解锁，车灯尚未打开。环境状态与 Teacher 参考步骤一致，局部核验通过。
checks.后续执行: 撤去指导后，agent 调用 `setHeadlights(mode="on")` 打开车灯。车门保持解锁，任务核验通过。
